# All Flow commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/flow_cli_reference.py. Do not edit. -->

This page lists every command in `openadapt-flow` 2.2.0, the release
on PyPI, read from its argument parser. `openadapt flow COMMAND` and
`openadapt-flow COMMAND` are the same command. Run any command with
`--help` for its arguments. For what the commands do and how they fit
together, see the [command reference](cli.md).

## `admit`

Read the published release-admission ledger. Does not sign or issue an admission.

| Command | Long options |
|---|---|
| `openadapt flow admit` |   |
| `openadapt flow admit status` | `--check`, `--json`, `--ledger` |

- `admit status`: Print admitted vs not-admitted for Flow from the public ledger. Never mints a signature.

- `countersign dossier`: Export one offline-verifiable HTML or zip for a dispute
- `countersign exceptions`: List Seals queued on a REFUTED or INDETERMINATE outcome
- `countersign purge`: Export, then delete, closed exceptions past their retention period
- `countersign resolve`: Resolve an exception with a later verified Seal that links to it
- `countersign timestamp-baseline`: Timestamp a baseline read before the executor runs
- `countersign verify`: Check a Seal offline and show executor, verification tier, timestamps, and disclosures

- `fleet disallow`: Remove an app family or domain from the allowlist
- `fleet policy`: Sign or verify the promotion policy
- `fleet policy keygen`: Create a policy approver key (PEM, 0600)

- `fleet roles`: Add a workflow author or a policy approver (never both)
- `fleet simulate`: Run the three-tenant local simulator
- `fleet status`: Show opt-in, roles, policy and trust

## `for-each`

Author a DATA-DRIVEN LOOP bundle: wrap an existing single-demonstration bundle's linear body in a LOOP that runs once per record of a worklist (CSV/JSON), binding each record's columns to the workflow's parameters. Emits a program:true bundle the runtime executes bounded, $0, identity-gated and effect-verified per record

| Command | Long options |
|---|---|
| `openadapt flow for-each` | `--loop-var`, `--map`, `--max-iterations`, `--name`, `--out`, `--records`, `--relation` |

## `induce`

Induce a parameterized PROGRAM bundle from MULTIPLE recordings (multi-trace induction: infer params / loops / branches). REFUSES (nonzero exit, no bundle) when intent is underdetermined, printing a record-next worklist of missing demonstrations

| Command | Long options |
|---|---|
| `openadapt flow induce` | `--held-out`, `--name`, `--out` |

- `qualify accept`: Confirm every proposed pin in one command after the proposed oracle catches a --break-it fault. Refusing a pin HALTs.
- `qualify add-case`: Add a representative or fault case
- `qualify add-requalification`: Add a condition that requires this workflow to be requalified
- `qualify admit-local`: Sign a local-dev admission for an accepted proposal. The signer cannot enter a production trust map.
- `qualify business-decision`: Add, update, or inspect one reviewed finite business decision without editing the workflow manifest
- `qualify campaign`: Qualify a bundle from verify.yaml (also the default form: `qualify <bundle> --verify verify.yaml`)
- `qualify certify`: Persist a combined qualification and existing-policy decision
- `qualify drills`: Add the five readiness drills for the practice case's save and trust this computer's local drill key (a local campaign)
- `qualify explain`: Explain qualification coverage
- `qualify from-demo`: Propose pins from the demo, accept them, and optionally sign a local-dev admission. After record and compile.
- `qualify init`: Initialize a bundle's qualification project
- `qualify inspect`: Inspect qualification coverage
- `qualify judgment-cases`: Store or check reviewed local judgment cases; this command never synthesizes an executable rule from examples
- `qualify label`: Optionally set, remove, or list presentation-only entity labels
- `qualify label list`: List qualification-owned entity labels
- `qualify label remove`: Remove a step entity label
- `qualify label set`: Set an optional presentation label for one qualified step
- `qualify propose`: Draft application, environment, identity, and effect pins from the compiled demo. Missing pins HALT; nothing is guessed. Runs the proposed oracle against a --break-it fault.
- `qualify report`: Report qualification coverage
- `qualify run`: Import case results produced by the Desktop/local/customer-controlled qualification runner
- `qualify run-case`: Run one current qualification case (the practice item or a readiness drill) with Flow-owned Standard authorization
- `qualify schema`: Print the qualification-project JSON Schema
- `qualify set-effect`: Assign verification-strength tier to an existing effect
- `qualify set-identity`: Set exact/normalized identity fields and their quorum
- `qualify set-risk`: Confirm an action's reviewed business-risk classification
- `qualify trust-runner`: Trust an Ed25519 qualification-runner public key

## `repair`

Governed repair promotion lifecycle: register a proposed (healed or taught) bundle as a CANDIDATE, review its diff, run the replay and fault campaigns, approve (human), stage, canary, and roll back. A proposed bundle NEVER becomes active without this lifecycle. See docs/REPAIR_LIFECYCLE.md

| Command | Long options |
|---|---|
| `openadapt flow repair` |   |
| `openadapt flow repair approve` | `--approved-by`, `--non-interactive`, `--store` |
| `openadapt flow repair campaign` | `--kind`, `--store` |
| `openadapt flow repair canary` | `--max-runs`, `--store` |
| `openadapt flow repair canary-record` | `--run-dir`, `--store` |
| `openadapt flow repair list` | `--store` |
| `openadapt flow repair register` | `--evidence`, `--prior`, `--source`, `--store` |
| `openadapt flow repair review` | `--reviewed-by`, `--store` |
| `openadapt flow repair rollback` | `--by`, `--candidate-id`, `--store` |
| `openadapt flow repair show` | `--json`, `--store` |
| `openadapt flow repair stage` | `--store` |
| `openadapt flow repair status` | `--store` |

- `repair approve`: HUMAN approval gating promotion; refuses unless the diff was reviewed and BOTH campaigns passed. Binds the exact bundle hashes
- `repair campaign`: Run a campaign against the candidate's evidence frames: 'replay' (healthy drift battery must all pass) or 'fault' (ambiguity / wrong-entity / stale-target / dialog / verifier-failure frames must all be REFUSED)
- `repair canary`: Atomically activate the staged bundle in CANARY mode: a bounded first-N-runs window with per-run verification before full active
- `repair canary-record`: Record one canary run from its run directory; any silent-incorrect or verification regression auto-reverts to the prior bundle
- `repair list`: List candidates and their lifecycle states
- `repair register`: Register a (prior, proposed) bundle pair as a repair candidate; refuses (fail closed) any contract weakening without a new qualification revision
- `repair review`: Record a human review of the candidate's diff
- `repair rollback`: One-command rollback: restore the prior bundle hash as the active pointer
- `repair show`: Show a candidate's reviewable diff, campaigns, and state
- `repair stage`: Copy BOTH bundles into the store by content hash and re-verify them byte-exact (prior too, so rollback is always local)
- `repair status`: Show the atomic active-bundle pointer and its lineage

## `service`

Unattended on-prem service: run, health, restart, egress audit

| Command | Long options |
|---|---|
| `openadapt flow service` |   |
| `openadapt flow service boot-check` | `--account`, `--root` |
| `openadapt flow service egress-audit` | `--interval`, `--pid`, `--root`, `--samples` |
| `openadapt flow service health` | `--label`, `--max-age`, `--restart-on-fail`, `--root`, `--stuck-after` |
| `openadapt flow service notices` | `--ack`, `--all`, `--by`, `--root` |
| `openadapt flow service pf` |   |
| `openadapt flow service pf check` | `--pf-conf`, `--user` |
| `openadapt flow service pf render` | `--allow-file`, `--out`, `--user` |
| `openadapt flow service restart` | `--label` |
| `openadapt flow service run` | `--allow-outbound`, `--max-cycles`, `--poll-seconds`, `--queue-script`, `--root` |

- `service boot-check`: After a restart: wait for the service account to sign in; alert if late
- `service egress-audit`: Sample the service process tree's sockets; exit 0 only if no peer is off the machine
- `service health`: Check the service; exit 1 when unhealthy
- `service notices`: List or acknowledge service notices
- `service pf`: macOS pf rules for the service account (text only)
- `service pf check`: Check a rendered anchor (and pf.conf)
- `service pf render`: Render the anchor from the allow list
- `service restart`: Ask the service manager to restart the service
- `service run`: Run the queue loop (what launchd/systemd keeps alive)

- `triage approve-batch`: Approve a plan's clean batch
- `triage calibrate`: Fit a calibration artifact from labels
- `triage decide`: Approve or decline one save
- `triage eligibility`: Check whether a workflow may switch to only asking about problems: a pinned, eligible calibration artifact and an audit miss-rate bound under the target. Exit 0 eligible, 3 not yet, 2 no evidence.
- `triage estimate`: Estimate the miss rate from audit labels
- `triage plan`: Write a triage plan; print the review view
